title: chat-stasher inbox bundle
description: One captured conversation bundle handed from the extension to the CLI. This file is the single source of truth for both sides: changing it requires changing apps/extension/lib/contract.ts and crates/chat-stasher/src/inbox.rs together.

schema.description: @1 has no identity field; the CLI reads an @1 bundle as identity {level:'default', value:''}.

raw.description: The raw response. Authoritative: a wrong parse can always be redone from here.

identity.description: Since @2. For web platforms the identity axis is the account, not the machine (ADR-002): two machines capturing the same conversation must produce the same id so it dedups. level 'default' means the identity is unreliable, and the CLI must fall back to platform:sessionId as the dedup key.
